blurb: Bay Forest Golf Club offers an 18-hole golf course with green fees varying by residency, age, and time. The club provides memberships, lessons for adults and juniors, a driving range with practice facilities, and hosts tournaments and outside events. Amenities include a pro shop and a bar & grill.
extraNote: Weekday and Senior rates are in effect Monday-Thursday and before 11:00 AM Friday, excluding holidays · Weekend rates are in effect on Fridays after 11 a.m., Saturday, Sunday and holidays
